text:
Maya R: noticed an odd set of invoice preview deltas — some tenants show traffic attributed to the fallback bucket even though clients include route tags. looks like ~0.9% of daily traffic affected.
Tom H: rough idea where the break is? proxy header passthrough or the enrichment stage?
Maya R: preliminary logs suggest older mobile SDKs omit the X-Client-Route header. also saw the proxy rewrite header for requests that passed through our caching layer.
Priya K: user impact: console per-route breakdowns are noisy; customers comparing preview vs actual ledger see discrepancies. that's the root cause for a support spike yesterday.
Oliver V: suggestion: introduce a dedicated metering header X-RW-Metering that carries route_id and pricing_bucket. backend will prefer this header over resolver output when present.
Console Bot: note — changing attribution logic can create non-idempotent previews. recommend a staged rollout with visible markers in the preview UI.
Finance Ops: must preserve invoice correctness. minor UX blips are ok for a short window, but we need a reconciliation alert if preview drift > 1% value for any tenant.
Maya R: header format proposal (proto):
```
X-RW-Metering: rid=route:eu-2a-07;plan=enterprise-std;v=1
X-RW-Metering-Sig: hmac=base64(hmac_sha256(tenant_key, header_payload))
```
Tom H: security: signed hints preferred. unsigned hints should be accepted only when coming from trusted agents (e.g., our hosted SDKs), otherwise treat as advisory and do not change billing unless explicitly allowed.
Priya K: telemetry changes: emit fields: metering_hint_seen, metering_hint_signed, metering_hint_trusted, metering_hint_applied. add these to preview logs and the billing event stream for reconciliation.
Oliver V: rollout plan I propose:
- phase A (observe): 1% traffic, parse hints, log telemetry, DO NOT change invoice attribution.
- phase B (trusted apply): 10% traffic, honor signed hints for tenants on enterprise contracts; surface an "attribution delta" card in console.
- phase C (wider apply): 100% for all SDKs, mark unsigned hints as untrusted in telemetry but allow apply after a TTL and admin opt-in.
QA Bot: tests needed: header parsing unit tests, proxy e2e with passthrough enabled/disabled, preview end-to-end to compare ledger vs preview under different phases. fuzz malformed header cases.
Maya R: console UX: add a small banner on invoice preview when mixed attribution is detected: "Some usage in this window used client-provided route hints. This may cause differences from prior previews." allow customers to toggle showing hinted attribution.
Finance Ops: also create a nightly reconciliation job during rollout which flags tenants where preview vs ledger diff > $250/day and creates a ticket for finance ops.
Tom H: implementation plan: lightweight parser library in go + proxy changes (nginx lua or envoy filter) + enrich service preference change + preview API param include_hints=true/false + console banner and toggle.
Oliver V: rough estimates: proxy+parser 6 business days, enrich changes + telemetry 5 days, console + preview API 3 days. work can run in parallel.
Maya R: canary runbook items: metrics to watch (per-tenant delta %, absolute $ delta, rate of hinted events), rollback conditions (sustained delta > 2% for >3 hours for any tenant), communication plan.
Console Bot: created task: console PR draft -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/10101
Tom H: platform PR started: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/12777 (parser + proxy config)
Priya K: add a console filter so SRE can view only hinted traffic and compare time-series. also include sample_id in logs for tracing.
Finance Ops: requirement: embargoed customer note for enterprise accounts explaining the change and expected preview behaviour during canary. include opt-out instructions.
Maya R: approval needed from security on HMAC key management before phase B. Security owning that?
QA Bot: also: add CI lint rule in proxy pipeline to reject requests with headers that look malformed or exceed expected size to prevent injection/flood attempts.
Tom H: agree. will add lint and alerts.
metering-bot: [automated] sample telemetry: ts=7743216600 tenant=starlabs metering_hint_seen=true metering_hint_signed=false metering_hint_applied=false resolver=default
Priya K: action owners: Tom (proxy + parser + tests), Oliver (enrich + telemetry spec), Maya (canary runbook + run), Console Bot (UI overlay + preview toggle), Finance Ops (recon job + customer comms), QA Bot (test matrix + CI lint).
Maya R: OK. I'll coordinate the first 1% canary next Monday. post any follow-ups here.
Tom H: quick nudge 97 keep the header compact, avoid including extraneous free-text fields. makes signing simpler.
Priya K: noted.
Console Bot: thread summary: proposed X-RW-Metering header, telemetry fields, 3-phase rollout, PR links, reconciliation alerts.
Maya R: thanks all. closing but will reopen if we hit odd deltas during canary.
